instruction: I want to enhance my privacy by blocking third-party cookies in Chrome. Can you configure this setting for me?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y

mkdir -p /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && if [ ! -f /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ]; then echo '{}' > /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences; fi && cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"profile":{"block_third_party_cookies":false}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to enable third-party cookie blocking in Chrome settings. The evaluator checks profile.block_third_party_cookies in Chrome Preferences file. Initial state: false (third-party cookies allowed). Expected state: true (third-party cookies blocked).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts profile.block_third_party_cookies from Chrome Preferences file and returns 'true' or 'false' as string
Metric exact_match correctly compares result with expected value using string equality
Expected value handling is correct: get_rule returns {'expected': 'true'} which metric accesses as rules['expected']
Data flow is semantically sound: getter returns string 'true'/'false', metric compares with expected string 'true'
Evaluator fully covers instruction requirement: checks whether third-party cookies are blocked
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure Preferences file is flushed to disk before evaluation
Initial state (false) and expected state (true) are correctly configured
